text: “They have both left us at the very time when we want them most.” It came to the turn of the man in the grey suit to transact his business at the counter. He paid in a cheque—received a receipt for it—and turned to go out. “What is to be done?” asked Mr. Bruff. “We can’t degrade ourselves by following him.” “I can!” I said. “I wouldn’t lose sight of that man for ten thousand pounds!” “In that case,” rejoined Mr. Bruff, “I wouldn’t lose sight of you, for twice the money.
